results.id: L|Package\Update Consulting Field  In Fund Main From Transfer Request|detailed
results.detail: Units 2-7 and 10 match: the LEFT JOIN on all of the account's funds (no existinfile filter), the six-field condition, the ISNULL derived columns (readWrite), Update Fund Main 1-5 to Gen_fundmainbase with no ModifiedOn, and the no-fund case. Unit 1 states 'בין מסלולים' / 'הסתיים' as fact, and its tech line drops the SQL-comment origin (DTSX:77202-77203). Units 8-9 leave out a business consequence. The request is marked when at least one of its fund rows updated successfully. Failed fund rows go only to Union Error All and the ETL warning, not to the Aggregate. So if a request has several funds and one fund update fails, the request is still marked 'copied to fund' and the failed fund is never retried, because the source requires gen_dateofcopyingconsultingdetailstofund IS NULL. Unit 11 ('the account's funds are synchronised') is therefore not guaranteed.

SQL: update Gen_customeraccountBase set TransactionCurrencyId = (select top 1 ... where CurrencyName = ?), ExchangeRate = 1.00000 where TransactionCurrencyId is null. Parameter 0 is User::CurrencyName = 'שקל חדש'. Accounts that already have a currency are untouched. The conditional '(if such a currency exists)' is correct.

All units are correct. CurrencyName has a design-time value and no expression. Set Variables' ReadWriteVariables are only CrmMinimumDate, OrganizationName and ServerName, and no other component references CurrencyName, so nothing in the package overrides it. There is no package configuration; a runtime /SET override cannot be seen in the files. The sub-select returns NULL when no currency has that name, and ExchangeRate is still set to 1. Precedence: Write To ETLProcessCounter 4 → this task → End ETL Process record (framework), so it is the last business step.
Source, decision, Unsupported UPDATE, and ExchangeRate = 1.00000 as a proven literal are correct. The Money/shekel meaning is correctly labelled השערה.
